description: Which incoming staff mail goes into CRM: the store's team addresses, and the domains whose mail never does. Turn CRM sync on per mailbox in its Email Account.

fields.label: Team addresses
fields.description: The shared addresses customers write to, such as sales@ or info@. Mail to one of them from someone new becomes a lead; mail to a staff member's own address goes into CRM only from a customer or a known lead.

fields.label: Reply-To for staff mail
fields.description: One of the team addresses. Mail staff send from their own mailbox asks the customer to reply to this address, so the conversation stays with the team. Empty: staff mailboxes keep their own Reply-To.

fields.label: Blocked sender domains
fields.description: One domain per line. Mail from these never becomes a lead.

fields.label: Our own domains
fields.description: One domain per line: the store's own mail, which never becomes a lead.

name: Lead Mail Settings
